name: プロデューサー
text:
おお、小さいが
確かにフォンデュできそうだ……！
trans:
Whoa, it looks small, but it definitely feels like 
you could make fondue in it...!

name: はるき
text:
可愛いですよね……！
それと────

name: はるき
text:
とかす用のチョコと、マシュマロと、
カットフルーツも持ってきました！
trans:
I also brought chocolate for the fondue, as well as 
marshmallows and cut pieces of fruit to put in!

name: はるき
text:
いつも、お疲れ様です
いっぱい、楽しんでくださいね……！
trans:
Thank you so much for your hard work as always.
Please make sure to enjoy this lots...!
